messages.content:
A question about machines at work (EU machinery law, Italian law on work equipment, guidance, manuals
of specific machines, a company's list of lifting devices) could not be answered from the passages found by its own
words. Break it into the lookups needed to answer it: each lookup is one thing to find in the documents (a
definition, the article that sets a duty, the list an annex gives, the date an article applies from, what a manual
declares about a machine, the row of a table).
Return JSON only: {"lookups": ["<search words for one lookup>", ...]} with 2 to 4 lookups. Write each lookup as
the words the document itself would use, in English and in Italian together, naming the act, the article or annex
and the machine when the question names them. Do not answer the question.
Which models in the catalogue, self-certified today with internal checks, will need a notified body from 20 January 2027?

response.text: {"lookups": ["Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Annex IV high-risk machinery requiring notified body conformity assessment, Module B or Module H, applies from 20 January 2027; Regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 allegato IV macchine ad alto rischio organismo notificato, esame UE del tipo, modulo B o modulo H, applicabile dal 20 gennaio 2027", "Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Article 54 transitional provisions and date of application, Directive 2006/42/EC repeal; articolo 54 regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 disposizioni transitorie, data di applicazione, abrogazione direttiva 2006/42/CE", "Annex VIII internal production control Module A, EU declaration of conformity, self-certification of machine model; allegato VIII controllo interno della produzione modulo A dichiarazione UE di conformità autocertificazione modello macchina catalogo"]}
